description: allows the loopback-hosted app content (dev / standalone) in the main window to invoke the app's shell commands over a remote origin (e.g. open_comfyui_window) plus the updater/process plugin commands (check / downloadAndInstall / restart) needed by the settings 「应用更新」section. App commands are only reachable from a remote origin when both declared in the AppManifest (build.rs) and granted here via their auto-generated allow-* permission.
